findings.evidence: F ≈ 96,485 C/mol e⁻ is correct. Dividing charge by F gives moles of electrons; multiplying moles of substance by molar mass gives mass. Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu(s) requires 2 mol e⁻ per mol Cu, and 2 × 96,485 = 192,970 C ≈ 1.93 × 10⁵ C. The worked answer matches the numbered steps, and no qualifying card overlap was found.
